compliance_checks.name: Refrigerant Leak Rate Threshold
compliance_checks.required_action: Mandatory repair within 30 days and follow-up verification test.

compliance_checks.name: Target Superheat / Subcooling Check
compliance_checks.required_action: Adjust TXV or refrigerant charge if outside ±3°F of OEM spec.

compliance_checks.name: Liquid Line Filter Drier Pressure Drop
compliance_checks.required_action: Replace filter drier if temperature drop exceeds 2°F across drier.
